en: Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor clinging ... (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five;
under object condition there are two ... pe ... under resultant condition there is one ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are five.
Dependent on a state that is neither a canker nor an affliction ... (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, there are five; in the object condition, two ... pe ... in the ripening condition, one ... pe ... in the non-disappearance condition, five.
